midnight-base.$description: Midnight Base — Deepest dark for backgrounds and primary text in contrast to lighter elements.

charcoal-surface.$description: Charcoal Surface — Secondary background color for cards and panels, creating subtle depth.

slate-accent.$description: Slate Accent — Button backgrounds and subtle dividers, a slightly warmer dark gray than the surfaces.

ghost-text.$description: Ghost Text — Primary text color and borders against dark backgrounds.

cool-gray-text.$description: Cool Gray Text — Secondary text, navigation items, and less prominent information.

subtle-gray-text.$description: Subtle Gray Text — Tertiary text or subdued headings, creating hierarchy through reduced contrast.

indigo-button.$description: Indigo Button — Active button state or highlighted elements, a deep violet that is muted but distinct.

replica-regular.$description: Primary display and body text for most content. The consistent `-0.014em` letter spacing creates a subtly compact, intentional feel across all sizes, distinguishing it from conventional sans-serifs.

replica-mono.$description: Used for specific headings, likely for numbers or code-like elements where a monospace feel is desired without reducing readability.

arial.$description: Rarely used, primarily for small, functional button text, retaining a system-level efficiency.
